card.alive_premise: One partner discovers that the other has quietly kept evidence of all the versions of them that never became achievements.
card.moment_origin_detail: No Aachu/Zuv lived fact is claimed. Specific abandoned drafts or attempts require creator confirmation before personalization.
card.title: The Museum of Almost
card.concrete_moment: During a desk clear-out, one partner puts a worn folder in the discard pile. The other retrieves it. Inside are crossed-out applications, rough sketches and unfinished plans from different eras. The owner tries to close it; the keeper arranges the pieces by date. The owner then adds today's unfinished draft instead of throwing it away.
card.universal_truth: Being deeply witnessed can mean someone remembers your becoming, not only the version that eventually succeeded.
card.audience_mirror: People whose partner knew them through abandoned ambitions, changing identities, awkward beginnings or seasons they dismiss as wasted.
card.scroll_stop: A partner urgently rescues the least impressive-looking folder from a discard pile.
card.emotional_contradiction: The owner sees embarrassing evidence of things that went nowhere; the partner sees a record of how far one person travelled.
scene_proof: The folder moves from drawer to discard pile and back into the partner's hands.
Distinct unfinished artifacts emerge while the owner's posture changes from dismissal to embarrassment.
The keeper lays the artifacts into a visible chronology without praising or explaining them.
The owner places a current unfinished draft at the end, changing a secret archive into a shared living record.
card.relationship_motion: One partner protects the archive; the other initially rejects it, recognizes what has been witnessed, and voluntarily continues the record.
retention_ladder: A familiar decluttering action creates an immediate discard decision.
The unusually quick rescue makes the folder consequential.
The contents overturn the expectation of achievements or romantic keepsakes.
The chronology turns clutter into evidence of becoming.
Adding today's draft proves the discovery changed the owner.
card.payoff: The archive gives dignity to the versions of a person that existed before certainty, applause or success.
card.dm_send_reason: Send it to the person who saw you before anything worked: you remembered me when I could not see a story yet.
card.format_recommendation: Carousel as one continuous drawer-to-folder discovery with escalating artifact reveals and a final physical addition.
card.asot_turn: The romantic archive contains no conventional milestones—only unfinished selves one partner considered worth keeping.
card.novelty_fingerprint: witness + rescued discard + unfinished selves instead of milestones + embarrassment-to-dignity + current draft added
risks: A curated scrapbook treatment would feel manufactured.
Specific documents cannot be attributed to Aachu or Zuv without confirmation.
